calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a revised production character design based VERY CLOSELY on reference 1 (approved mystery witch), retaining the costume, face concealment, body proportions, silhouette language, colors and sun details. Reference 2 is the old modular sheet, only useful for matching the painterly style; correct its poor sleeve construction. A single full body elegant adult magical heroine, three-quarter facing right, pink/ivory/gold layered angular cloak/dress, wide sun-pin hat, pink ribbon, platinum-white hair wisps, very pale ivory skin, only a small unmarked chin visible in dark hat shadow (no eyes, nose or lips). Fully clothed naturally fuller bust. Bare feet. Stylized painted flat polygonal brush planes like Slay the Spire, not realistic anatomy rendering.
PRIMARY CORRECTION: exactly TWO visible hands, one emerging from EACH separate full sleeve with clear wrist and cuff. Viewer-right arm gently bent outward holding the gold sun wand in front to the right, clear grip and forearm; viewer-left arm naturally lowers and extends gently diagonally OUTSIDE the cloak on the left, elbow softly bent, relaxed visible open fingers around hip level. Both shoulder→elbow→cuff→hand chains must be anatomically coherent, not arms pasted on chest, not sleeve swallowing hand, no second sleeve hidden inside torso. The cape drapes BEHIND the arms and has natural arm openings at either shoulder. Visible negative space separates both wrists from torso. Keep gold-leaf embroidery on ivory sleeves and cloak.
STANCE: elegant contrapposto, weight on one straight supporting leg, other knee relaxed and foot gently forward/side at a small graceful angle. Feet separated and comfortably grounded, no crossed legs, no stiff broad-legged A stance, no exaggerated hip sway or ballet tiptoes. Make her appear tall and graceful, retain the approved long angular layered hem but legs remain readable below it.
Full figure includes complete hat, wand and both feet, centered on transparent background, no ground oval/shadow, no text. This is a corrected pose of SAME character, not a new costume.

Use case: precise-object-edit, production 2D cutout-animation asset sheet. Image 1 is the exact approved pose/costume reference to dissect; Image 2 is the old modular asset style reference only, do NOT copy its wrongly hidden/fused arms.
Reconstruct the SAME pink/ivory/gold mystery witch costume from image 1 as SIX completely SEPARATE clean painted modular pieces on a true transparent background. Stylized polygonal painterly game art, same angular brush shapes, no black outline, not realistic. No hat/head/hair because existing original head will be retained.
LAYOUT on a large square sheet, generous empty margins between parts, 3 columns by 2 rows, each part fully visible and NOT touching adjacent parts.
TOP LEFT: continuous ARM-LESS front torso/dress from collar to long layered diamond hem. Same full-covered natural bust, pink central fitted cloth, gold leaf near bottom, cream inner diamond hem, tiny ivory collar and gold sun brooch. IMPORTANT: shoulders end in clean hidden joint caps; there are NO sleeves, hands, arms, side cape panels or legs painted on the torso. Narrow elegant silhouette, relaxed subtly asymmetrical waist matching reference.
TOP MIDDLE: only the rear pink/ivory cape drape with angular tails, NO body, no sleeves, no hands. Includes high shoulder attachment and extends behind skirt.
TOP RIGHT: the COMPLETE viewer RIGHT staff arm from shoulder joint to elbow to cuff to grasping hand. Shoulder points upper-left, elbow gently bends, forearm angles upper-right, as in image 1. Ivory bell sleeve, gold edge and leaves, pink lining. Hand fully outside cuff, pale ivory white skin. Hand grips a SHORT small gold rod stub only, at matching roughly 22-degree rightward angle; no full sun wand (we keep the existing wand).
BOTTOM LEFT: COMPLETE viewer LEFT free arm from shoulder joint to softly bent elbow to cuff to a relaxed elegant open hand. Arm slopes DOWN-LEFT from shoulder at upper-right to visible relaxed fingertips at lower-left, exactly like image 1. Ivory long bell sleeve with gold border/leaf and pink lining. Hand is fully beyond the cuff. Make a real continuous sleeve with smooth upper joint and full anatomical arm; no amputated cuff, no hand hidden, no extra fingers. Pale ivory white skin, NOT peach/orange.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: only rear/support bare leg from lower thigh through natural knee to bare foot. Graceful support leg gently angled and foot pointing nearly forward with subtle turn. Pale porcelain/ivory white skin, faceted shading in cool soft gray rose, NO orange/tan, no shoes. Complete toe shape and overlap allowance at thigh root.
BOTTOM RIGHT: only front/relaxed bare leg from lower thigh through softly relaxed knee to bare foot pointing somewhat right. Elegant natural standing, not crossed, not tiptoe, no extreme arch. Pale porcelain ivory white skin matching hands. Complete toes with generous canvas margin.
Every piece should be individually usable with filled concealed joint overlap. No artificial cast shadows, no glow, no background pattern or opaque color, no text/grid/labels. Preserve identity and clothing palette from image 1; skin is paler than image1. All six components remain sharply defined and non-overlapping.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT image 1 (the production asset atlas), with image 2 ONLY as a SKIN-COLOR swatch. This is a highly localized color correction, not a redesign.
Keep image 1's exact 1024x1536 canvas, exact layout, exact object bounds, outlines, pose, hat, hair, dark concealed face, costume, staff, flame, and transparent alpha. ONLY change the visible CHIN and small neck skin patch on BOTH heads in the top row from warm peach/orange to very pale cool ivory porcelain white like the hands and thighs in image 2. Preserve the angular painterly shading but use pale gray-rose shadows, no tan or orange.
The faces remain concealed in dark hat shadow with only an unmarked chin visible: no new eyes, nose, lips, mouth or smile. Do not alter the chin outline or neck outline. Do not brighten the hat or dress. Do not transfer any costume, face, haircut or pose from image 2.
